Wood tones and painted finishes

A stained wood shutter can bring out the wood tones in your floor or furniture. For a painted look, compare the shutter finish with your window trim to see whether you want the colors to match.

For a bathroom or a room that gets strong sun, consider Palm Beach™ vinyl shutters, designed for moisture and sun exposure. The collections below let you compare them with wood and composite options.

Shutter panels, louvers and light

Look at the panels as well as the louvers

Louver size changes the appearance of the shutter and the view when the louvers are open. Panel width and the number of panels affect how the shutters open into the room.

We check the depth of the window, projecting handles, nearby furniture and the room available for opening the panels. The frame can affect the fit and appearance, too. These choices are easier to settle before the shutters are ordered.

Privacy, daylight and bedroom light

Tilting the louvers lets you change the amount of daylight and the view into the room. Closing them gives more privacy, while opening the panels exposes more of the window.

Shutters can darken a room, but light can still enter between louvers and around the panels. If keeping a bedroom dark is especially important, tell us early. We'll talk through what the shutter can do and whether another treatment would help.

From measuring to the finished installation

John's background began with installation, and that experience still shapes how we look at a window. We check the mounting details and how the finished panels will operate before placing the order.

At installation, we check the fit and operation and show you how to use the shutters. Ask us about the panels, louvers or care instructions for the material you've chosen.

Questions about interior shutters

Ask John and Max: (818) 884-5464
Can shutters work on a door or an unusual window shape?

Some collections offer door and specialty-shape configurations. We'll review the shape, dimensions, hardware and clearance to see which options are suitable.

Should I choose a larger louver?

It depends on the look you prefer and the depth of the window. We'll show you the available sizes and consider the view, proportions and clearance together.

What affects the cost of custom shutters?

The material, window size, panel arrangement, frame and finish all contribute. After professional measuring and product selection, we can prepare a quote for your windows.
